experiment_scope.question: Within the selected AHU recordings, how do final-step, attention, and combined temporal summaries change descriptive diagnostic errors, class recall and review workload?
experiment_scope.data: Selected 45 G36-1wk source runs; existing LBNL SZVAV/SZCAV files are exploratory target data
experiment_scope.condition_unit: Seasonal shared-weather week across baseline and fault severities
experiment_scope.within_condition_time_separation: Earlier/later days in the same shared-weather week; not independent-condition train/validation separation
experiment_scope.retained_claim: Descriptive, conditional results on these recordings and implemented workflow controls

architecture_experiments.name: E1_pooling
architecture_experiments.question: Does attention pooling change errors relative to final-step pooling?
architecture_experiments.fixed: Data, RF/encoder/optimizer settings, training budget, seed, fusion and scoring

architecture_experiments.name: E2_combination
architecture_experiments.question: Does combining final-step and attention summaries improve the diagnostic tradeoff?
architecture_experiments.change: Combine both summaries with a learned head
architecture_experiments.fixed: Same data, RF/encoder/optimizer settings, training budget, seed, fusion and scoring; parameter count changes are reported

interpretation_limits: Data share weather, occupancy and simulated system dynamics; time separation does not create new independent conditions.
Macro F1 and per-class metrics are development descriptions, not estimates of transfer to unseen buildings.
Published target schedules/labels were explored earlier; withholding y arrays later does not restore a sealed holdout.
Matching units and nominal signal roles do not prove matching multi-zone and single-zone dynamics.
Probability thresholds and rule tests demonstrate policy behavior, not verified diagnostic safety.

data_rebuild.note: New pack hashes and protocol are frozen for ALL three new runs. Historical numbers remain separate; no historical model is reconstructed from metadata.

review_policy: Review below the provisional confidence threshold or when the two branches disagree. This is not a validated target error guarantee.
training_scope: core-valid, occupied, fan-on; off/unoccupied cases are outside the first trained operating scope
feedback_provenance: Simulated technician from pre-existing published reference; not real technician intervention
